summary: Measure a quiescent integration process and reject injected busy CPU with the same idle-budget check.

replay.detail: Test fixture only; no production replay or rebuild change.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration change.

rules.detail: No authority, projection or checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: Adds a Unix integration test using existing process CPU accounting and test supervision; no protocol or client change.

downtime.detail: No production runtime change or restart required.

manual.detail: No manual production step. Ordinary integration CI runs the control.

recovery.detail: Test-owned busy thread stops on completion or drop; production recovery is unchanged.
